svg.title: Worldline map 2022 to 2027
svg.desc: Two worldlines: alpha (chemistry: IISER Kolkata, DFT catalyst study, ChemEnigma 1st, Molecule3D) and beta (AI: TREC 2024, FIRE 2025, two MeitY startups, ECIR 2026 AgriIR, UIDAI hackathon 1st prize) converging in 2026 into the Steins Gate line: the MS thesis on Lean 4 formal proofs and mixture-of-experts RNA structure.
